races.title: State House, District 3
races.note: The top two finishers from the Nov 3, 2026 count. Everyone else in this race is coming.

cands.name: Steve Tyson
cands.bio: Republican state representative for North Carolina House District 3 (Craven County) since 2021 and Deputy Majority Leader. Army veteran (1973–1976), licensed general contractor, real estate broker and small business owner. Served 12 years as a Craven County Commissioner, two terms as chairman.
cands.gaps: We could not find his date or exact place of birth beyond "Craven County." His upbringing and Craven County residence come only from his own campaign website. We found no documented statements or actions on data centers, homestead property tax elimination, limits on investor or foreign land buying, H-1B or immigration enforcement, police pay and pensions, abortion, or school choice and teacher pay. His stated interest in waterway protection and his economic-development goals are general and do not address specific development or growth-limit proposals. Ballotpedia lists no endorsements for him in 2026, and his campaign site's endorsements page was not included in what we could read. The 'On the Issues' page of his campaign site was cut off in the transportation section. The bills he has sponsored were not available. Ballotpedia's list of his board service is self-reported and was not independently verified.

local.label: Roots 100: His campaign website says he is a native of Craven County and has lived there his entire life except for his active-duty Army service.

score.why: Raised $0, under $5,000 for this office: too little money to score fairly.

qual.background: Member of the NC House since 2021 and Deputy Majority Leader. He chaired the House Finance and Transportation committees in 2023-24 and held other House committee posts. Before that he served 12 years as a Craven County Commissioner, two terms as chairman. He is a licensed general contractor, real estate broker and small business owner of over 35 years.
qual.why: He has several years of legislative service plus chamber leadership as Deputy Majority Leader, on top of 12 years in local elected office and a long business career. Committee chairmanships were not counted toward the score.

cands.name: Diannia Bright
cands.bio: Democrat who ran for North Carolina House District 3 in 2026. Her campaign site says she has taught special education for over 22 years, was Lenoir County Public Schools' Special Education Teacher of the Year for 2021–22, and works as a mental health Qualified Professional. It also says she is a county commissioner in Dover.
cands.gaps: We could not find where Diannia Bright was born or raised, or when she moved to North Carolina. We found no independent record, such as county government pages or news coverage, confirming her county commissioner seat or its dates. We found no public statements from her on data centers, property taxes, land ownership, growth and development, immigration, campaign money, policing, guns, abortion, school choice or teacher pay. Her campaign site names only education, healthcare and mental health services as priorities. She did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey. We found no news coverage of controversies and no documented foreign ties. The only endorsements found came from two informal online voting-guide groups, which we did not treat as notable.

score.why: Raised $0, under $5,000 for this office: too little money to score fairly.
score.why_money: Raised $0, under $5,000 for this office: too little money to score fairly.

qual.background: Her campaign site lists over 22 years as a special education teacher in Lenoir County, 14 years at Caswell Center, over 20 years as a Qualified Professional at Human Resource Unlimited in New Bern, and a current seat as a county commissioner in Dover.
qual.why: A local elected office puts her in the middle band. The office comes from her own campaign site only, and her main careers (teaching and mental-health services) are not legislative, policy or budget careers. She has no prior state legislative service.
